pages.title: About
pages.text: A dwarf planet in the Asteroid Belt. Tier 3 rocket. Gravity is about 24% of Earth's. There is no air and it is properly cold, so bring thermal protection and a suit against radiation.

pages.title: Resources
pages.text: Plenty of meteoric iron and dolomite crystals you will need later. Grab several stacks of dolomite at once to avoid coming back.

pages.title: The dungeon
pages.text: The boss is an Evolved Blaze. It drops a tier 4 key: use it on the treasure room with better GalaxySpace loot. Bring fire protection and canned food.
